g.text: employee_id + credential_kind (c idx where not replaced)
Supertype of every identity that belongs to
the provider. The id prefix shows the kind:
emp_… for employees, sys_… for system identities.
Never deleted: ending is a status.
Employees only: the foreign key targets the
employee subtype. One current credential per
kind; replaced credentials keep their history.
No credentials: they run inside the Worker.
unique index — s: single column · c: composite
